title: Marvel's Spider-Man Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Peter Parker
entities.description: A young man with spider powers who swings into action as Spider-Man, sells photos to J. Jonah Jameson and struggles with rent and bad luck.

entities.name: Cosmic Spider-Man
entities.description: A version of Peter Parker empowered by the Enigma Force with the greatest power and greatest responsibility.

entities.name: Aunt May
entities.description: Peter Parker's aunt, who thinks she hears him moving around upstairs.

entities.name: Anti-Venom
entities.description: A being who declares himself the cure for the sickness on the city.

entities.name: Hydro-Man
entities.description: A watery felon whom Spider-Man quips about.

entities.name: Mysterio
entities.description: Quentin Beck, a skilled showman who uses lights, special effects and holography for dramatic entrances.

entities.name: Otto Octavius
entities.description: A scientist-villain whose mechanical arms became his most formidable weapons; he boasts of his superior intellect.

entities.name: Superior Spider-Man
entities.description: Otto Octavius's version of Spider-Man, which he vows to become with his unparalleled genius.

entities.name: Sinister Six
entities.description: A group of villains presented to Spider-Man as his nightmare.

entities.name: Black Cat
entities.description: A cunning thief who taunts Spider-Man about his bad luck.

entities.name: Eddie Brock
entities.description: A man with a nose for the story who, together with a hungry partner, becomes Venom.

entities.name: Venom
entities.description: The combined being formed by Eddie Brock and his partner.

entities.name: Agent Venom
entities.description: Corporal Thompson, wounded in action and offered an experimental way to be all he could be.

entities.name: Morlun
entities.description: A devourer of Spiders, associated with the Inheritors.

entities.name: Inheritors
entities.description: Beings who stalk the Spiders across worlds, feeding on their life force.

entities.name: Spiders
entities.description: The spider-powered heroes across worlds, hunted by the Inheritors.

entities.name: Gwen Stacy
entities.description: A Spider with allies across the Great Web who boasts of having all the choices in the Multiverse.

entities.name: J. Jonah Jameson
entities.description: A gruff man who calls Peter's photos garbage yet buys them all.

entities.name: Harry Osborn
entities.description: Harry, urged to take the mask and avenge a fallen figure.

entities.name: Spider-Punk
entities.description: An anti-authority Spider who urges smashing the system.

entities.name: Lizard
entities.description: Dr. Curt Connors, who used lizard DNA to regrow his missing arm, with further consequences.

entities.name: Miles Morales
entities.description: A Spider-Man creating an all-new legacy.

entities.name: Radioactive Spider
entities.description: A glowing spider that bit Peter Parker.

entities.name: Enigma Force
entities.description: A force that granted Peter the greatest power.

entities.name: Jackal
entities.description: Professor Miles Warren, a geneticist who solves problems with clones and few ethics.

entities.name: Kraven the Hunter
entities.description: A hunter who finds honor in the primal.

entities.name: Mary Jane Watson
entities.description: A charismatic and confident woman born for the limelight.

entities.name: Mister Negative
entities.description: A being who claims to be both light and dark, and so all.

entities.name: Spider-Woman
entities.description: A feared heroine.

entities.name: The Spot
entities.description: Dr. Johnathon Ohnn, who had no problem breaking laws, physical or otherwise.

entities.name: Ultimate Green Goblin
entities.description: Osborn, whose lust for power was monstrous.

entities.name: Doc Ock's Tentacles
entities.description: Otto Octavius's mechanical arms, once tools of science, now weapons.

entities.name: Interdimensional Web Watch
entities.description: A device that opens a portal to bring Gwen's allies across the Great Web.

entities.name: Great Web
entities.description: The network across which Gwen's allies are found.

entities.name: Multiverse
entities.description: The many worlds, all of whose choices Gwen claims to have.

entities.name: Iron Spider suit
entities.description: A powerful new suit sent to Peter by Tony Stark, with strings attached.

entities.name: Tony Stark
entities.description: The man who sent Peter the Iron Spider suit.

entities.name: Peter Parker's Camera
entities.description: Peter's camera, with which he gets close-up photos.

events.summary: A glowing radioactive spider bites Peter Parker.
events.quote: "Ow! A spider! It bit me! But why is it glowing that way?" —Peter Parker

events.summary: Peter's landlord demands overdue rent or eviction.
events.quote: "You're a month late again, Parker! Give me my money or you're out on the street!"

events.summary: J. Jonah Jameson insults Peter's photos but buys them all.
events.quote: "The photos are garbage, Parker! I'll buy them all."

events.summary: Dr. Curt Connors uses lizard DNA to regrow his arm, with further effects.
events.quote: Dr. Curt Connors used lizard DNA to regrow his missing arm, but it didn't stop there.

events.summary: Wounded Corporal Thompson is offered an experimental enhancement.
events.quote: Wounded in action, Corporal Thompson was offered an experimental way to be all he could be.

events.summary: Eddie Brock and his partner join together as Venom.
events.quote: "I've got the nose for the story. He's got the hunger for the kill. Together..."

events.summary: Doctor Octopus unveils the Sinister Six to Spider-Man.
events.quote: "Open your eyes to your nightmare, Spider-Man." —Doctor Octopus, Otto Octavius

events.summary: Harry is urged to take the mask and seek vengeance.
events.quote: "It's time, Harry. Take the mask and avenge me."

events.summary: Otto Octavius vows to become the Superior Spider-Man.
events.quote: "I will be Spider-Man. With my unparalleled genius, I shall become the *Superior* Spider-Man." —Otto Octavius

events.summary: The Enigma Force grants Peter the greatest power.
events.quote: The Enigma Force granted Peter the greatest power, and with it, the greatest responsibility.

events.summary: The Interdimensional Web Watch opens a portal and Gwen's allies arrive from across the Great Web.
events.quote: The device crackled to life, the portal opened, and Gwen's allies across the Great Web poured forth.

events.summary: Peter receives the Iron Spider suit from Tony Stark, which comes with strings attached.
events.quote: Peter appreciated the powerful new suit sent by Tony Stark, but he soon found it came with some strings attached.
